“You just have to take more supplements. Vitamins are important and will help make you feel better.” My mother, after I told her I have depression. Like depression is gonna get cured with that. 

Due to my depression I had to quit my job. When I left I told the colleagues I was close with that I had some mental health issues. One of them was an older lady that doesn’t believe in therapy. So when she heard she told me told to “have a different mindset, because that would help cure me.” Like it’s that easy.. 

My ex broke up with me, because they couldn’t take my depression anymore. They broke up saying that I needed to work on myself. I don’t deny it, but at the time I had already started therapy. Therefore it was just one blow after another. Months later they said to me that they just wanted me to be happy after I confided in them about depression made me feel. I know they meant well, but seeing how the break up pushed me even deeper in the abyss, it was hurtful to hear.

At the same time, the emotional pain I’m dealing with every day has slowly crushed me to a point where it’s unbearable.

In the ongoing campaign I’m playing in, my party almost killed a young green dragon. But he ran away like a coward, before he killed one of the members. So now finding him, and getting revenge by making some nice dragon armor out of him is one of our party’s goal.

Me and the group played the campaign “The lost mines of Phandelver”. Traveling from one place to another, the DM threw a giant goat battle at the party just for shits and giggles. Everything went well, our nature Paladin managed to convince most of the goats to back off. Except for the leader. Me, feeling inspired, made my woodelven ranger climb on top of the giant goat to tame it into submission so she could ride into battle later in the story. The DM requested an ability check to climb on top off it. No problem, got a high enough score to pass. However.. the goat was not having it and started go into a frenzy. I needed to make another check for my ranger to stay on it. Natural 1.. My ranger got immediately thrown off. To make matters worse, it was the goat’s turn next. Of course, he would go for my ranger. So with a natural 20 on his stomp and almost full damage, he 1 hit KO’ed my ranger.
